entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What do you think you're doing with her?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I won't harm her—it's in her best interest that you turn back.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You've made clear that you reject the reality she desires.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The reality where she lives as Kasumi Yoshizawa...
This isn't reality.
This is wrong.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It saddens me when you speak that way.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Don't you understand? You deny her wishes[n]when you say such things.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: "Her wishes," huh?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: This isn't just for her—I'm doing all of this for yourselves as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hmm?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I honestly do want to come to terms with you. We should talk.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Think about it: you both have dreams, no?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I have the power to make them come true.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: My reality can become just the way you like.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Total waste of my time.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: A shame... but I understand.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well then, we just have to resort to force now, don't we?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Violence is not my thing...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I agree, though. It seems we're out of options here.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Time to fight. Are you ready?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Keep up—and don't embarrass me.
